openings.claim: Pencil pattern-specific quantities and pattern names on envelopes; mark quantities only after filling, integrating checks and making assignments visible.
openings.discriminator: Quantity confusion predicts checklist benefits with shared trays; interference predicts local loose materials improve omissions and crossing reaches without checklists. Matched local success with persistent checked-tray omissions defeats the central explanation.
openings.probe: Compare equal matched-mixture incumbent, shared-tray checklist, and local-loose batches; alternate order, audit contents, and count omissions, reaches, and all preparation/filling/checking time. A subsequent 60-kit run must meet the correction limit.
openings.uncertainty: Exact quantities must be recoverable; writing overhead, table fit, full-run transfer, and later supply depletion remain unresolved. Exterior identification benefits are predicted, untested.

openings.claim: Pre-count exact materials for bounded batches; require an empty material pool before sealing so an omitted item produces a residual release signal.
openings.discriminator: Local staging may prevent picking omissions but supplies no distinct filling-omission stop signal. Compensating extras can empty the pool despite omissions, defeating residuals as sufficient verification.
openings.probe: Stage at most twelve kits with the actual mixture; briefly omit one required item before sealing, observe its residual, restore it, audit individual contents, and record reconciliation time. Stop expansion if footprint or projected total time fails constraints.
openings.uncertainty: Pre-counting accuracy, recoverable specifications, footprint, and timing are unproven; counting errors create false alarms and extras cancel omissions.

lineage.reason: Preserves quantity guidance, identification, and interference comparison.
Distinct residual signal and cancellation failure retained.

decision: Probe both; neither is validated. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers within 90 minutes, the existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, existing envelopes/supplies, and no purchases/equipment. Target 60 ready kits with at most one distribution correction. Evidence is synthetic; small-batch mixture, omission stage, and opened-packet footprint remain unknown.
